name: PlainWeather - Weather Safety
subtitle: Offline weather safety
shortDescription: 14 hazard guides, 28 safety tools, 11 go/no-go checklists — fully offline and free, with optional ad removal. No signal needed when it matters most.
longDescription:
Existing weather apps need a live connection to tell you the forecast. PlainWeather is different: it's the offline safety-action layer that works when the signal drops — exactly the moment a severe-weather app matters most.

14 HAZARD ACTION GUIDES, FREE FOREVER
Step-by-step before/during/after guidance for tornado, hurricane, flash flood, wildfire, blizzard, heatwave, lightning, hail, dust storm, storm surge, tsunami, avalanche, rip current, and derecho — including a Myths & Mistakes section per hazard debunking real misconceptions (the overpass "shelter" myth, opening windows for tornadoes, and more).

28 SAFETY CALCULATORS & REFERENCE TOOLS
A live lightning flash-to-bang countdown, heat index, wind chill/frostbite, WBGT work-rest estimator, dew point, snow load, Beaufort wind scale, sunburn time-to-burn, a plain-language Watch vs. Warning explainer, regional seasonal risk profiles, air quality and UV guides, marine advisories, and prep checklists for families, vehicles, power outages, and evacuation routes.

11 ACTIVITY GO/NO-GO GUIDES
Weather-driven decision checklists for hiking and outdoor work, farming frost windows, fishing and boating conditions, cycling and running, construction stoppage thresholds, school outdoor-activity heat guidance, your daily commute, and road-trip and travel planning — built for outdoor workers, parents, commuters, and travelers alike.

### Built for the Moment the Signal Drops
• 100% offline for every safety-critical feature — no network required on any path that keeps you safe.
• An optional, opt-in offline peer-to-peer alert relay can pass a cached warning to nearby PlainWeather users over Bluetooth/Wi-Fi with zero internet and zero server.
• Kids' and Elderly accessibility profiles, an icon-first low-literacy mode, and read-aloud guides for every hazard and activity.
• Full Spanish translation, with more languages planned.
• A printable/shareable household safety card for anyone without a smartphone.

### Your Information Stays Yours
PLAINWEATHER PRO (OPTIONAL, NEVER SAFETY-CRITICAL)
Every hazard guide, every safety tool, and every go/no-go checklist is free, forever — full stop. PlainWeather Pro is available as either a one-time purchase or a monthly subscription — your choice — adding convenience depth only: a Historical Worst-Case Reference (how bad each hazard has actually gotten, with real examples), Pollen & Seasonal Allergy Notes, an Event & Wedding Weather Planner, and Gardening Frost Protection guidance. A lapsed or cancelled subscription never removes anything safety-critical.

IMPORTANT: PlainWeather provides general safety guidance for informational purposes and is not a substitute for official emergency instructions. Always follow guidance from your local emergency management authorities.
whatsNew: PlainWeather now shows ads in its free content (Google AdMob; you will see a consent prompt where required). A one-time "Remove Ads" purchase removes them. Restore Purchases is in Settings. Existing purchases are unchanged.
monetization: Free with ads, optional monthly ad-free
